name: hero_sheet
prompt: Character reference sheet for a 1990s PC-98 Japanese adventure game: authentic low-resolution pixel art, limited 16-color palette, visible checkerboard dithering, hard dark outlines, on a flat dark violet background. The same character shown three times: full-body front view standing, full-body side view, and a large head-and-shoulders close-up. He is a skinny, pale 20-year-old post-soviet 'nefor' boy with the magnetic burnt-out cool of an underground soundcloud rapper: shaggy bleached-blond hair with dark roots hanging over his eyes, a grey fur ushanka hat with dangling ear flaps, heavy dark circles under half-lidded eyes, an oversized black zip hoodie, enormous flared black jeans pooling over beat-up sneakers, a silver chain with a small cross. Gloomy deadpan expression, slouched posture. Palette: near-black violet, dusty purple, teal shadows, bone-white skin, a single accent of blood red. No text, no labels, no UI.
